resourceName: The VCF Group Biogas Projects at Nipat and Songphol Farm
description: The project, using technology developed by the Energy Research and Development Institute (ERDI), Chiang Mai University, Thailand, involves the installation of High suspensions solid Up-flow Anaerobic Sludge Blanket (HUASB) reactors at 3 pig-farms under the VCF Group. The VCF group is a large pig farms company and the farms included under this project activity are named Nipat, Songphol 1 and Songphol 2. All farms are located in the Ratchaburi province in the southwest region of Thailand approximately 100 km west of Bangkok.
